title: Q-TRAJ-neglected-docs-doctrine: docs/doctrine had 414 lines of change, then nothing for 7 days while the rest of the system moved
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** trajectory pass (TRAJECTORY-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation trajectory --probe neglected:docs/doctrine
**Status:** closed

size: S
